authoringNote: The timeline strip runs under every beat and reads as one object, but it cannot BE one: iris and wipe transition only through visibility, so the engine demands sceneUnits, and sceneUnits truncates every layer at its beat s exit cut. The strip is therefore re-declared per beat, all seven copies driven by the same absolute clock (var(--t)). cut-families is the point of the film.
